item.title: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft for infringement
item.description: The Seattle Times and Newsday are just the latest plaintiffs to take OpenAI to court, alleging copyright infringement. The two outlets say the company used their journalism as training data for its AI models without permission and often reproduces passages from their reporting in response to user queries. item.title: The pros and cons of using wireless Android Auto
item.description: Wireless Android Auto delivers on the promise of making your life easier most of the time, but ditching the cable can come with a number of tradeoffs.

item.title: 10 Smart Gadgets That Could Instantly Upgrade Your Backyard
item.description: Smart outdoor tech is changing how people use their backyards, and this handful of clever upgrades can make your space more useful and enjoyable.

item.title: How to use your MacBook's built-in backup tool instead of paying for cloud storage
